translated_title: Mexico Reinforces Search Strategy with 10 Actions; Reports 13,625 People Located
original_title: Gobierno refuerza estrategia de búsqueda con 10 acciones; reporta 13 mil 625 localizaciones
author: Anahí Del Ángel
meta_description: Mexico reinforced its National Search Strategy with 10 new actions; of 31,946 people located, 13,625 were found since July 2025 through the strategy’s mechanisms.
